title: Commodity decision record
description: The commodity swarm's terminal machine record — written by .claude/agents/commodity/commodity-thesis/99_commodity-thesis-synthesis.md to commodity/runs/<COMMODITY>/decision_record.json. This is the commodity-scoped twin of the research swarm's decision_record.json (frameworks/DECISION_LEDGER.md §5) — a deliberately smaller shape (no scenario/forecast ledger; CLAUDE.md §10 scenario math does not apply to the single-verdict commodity dossier). Validated by scripts/validate_screener_json.py --fixture (schemas_root, per .claude/agents/commodity/SWARM.md).

data_needs.description: Optional, forward-looking. External data series whose absence caps this run's conviction (§11) — surfaced on the cockpit 'Data needs' dock so a durable connector can be built to feed them in continuously. The synthesizer emits the NEED (what / why / where it plugs in / a suggested source); the connector's implementation spec (endpoint, output schema, host allowlist) is authored later by the human at the approval/dispatch step, never here. A `filing_required` need is advisory only — no connector can satisfy it. Omitted or empty when nothing external is capping the call.

need_id.description: stable slug, unique within the run (connector idempotency key)

series.description: the missing data series in plain words, e.g. 'USDA WASDE US wheat ending stocks-to-use'

why_it_caps.description: why its absence limits conviction, tied to the §11 sufficiency read

cap_lifted.description: what sharpens once the series feeds in (optional)

filing_required.description: true = only a statutory filing can close this gap; a connector/scrape can NEVER satisfy it (structurally non-dispatchable). false = connector-eligible.

entry_modules.description: the module(s) that consume this series — they drive the scoped rerun when it arrives

name.description: the best source — an official / public-domain body preferred (USDA, NOAA, CFTC, an exchange) over a redistributor

licensing.description: known licensing / ToS note, or 'public_domain' (optional at emit; the human confirms it at approval)

tier.description: §4 source-tier ceiling this series can earn — NEVER 1-4 (a live feed is not a filing). An API / vendor feed is 5; a dated web scrape is 9 or 10.
